data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana slide as $90 billion exits crypto market
data.description: The crypto market shed more than $90 billion in value over a single 24-hour stretch, as Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana all moved lower together.Bitcoin traded around $61,982 on November 20, 2026. That put it down more than 13% over recent weeks.Ethereum changed hands between $1,700 and $1,800…
